svg.title: Proof so far, by skill
svg.desc: Ambitious: Blind A/B test, 7.06 vs 6.00 (blind A/B, older 1.2.3 body). Finish Work: Outside review, 72 → 95 (outside review score, 3 rounds). Council: Outside review, 5 → 7.5 (lowest seat score, 5-round self-review). Hill Climb: Outside review, 261/261 (runner self-test checks). T3 Code Conductor: Outside review, 6/6 (right calls in a cold run). Claude Conductor: Outside review, 5/6 (right calls in a cold run). Adversarial Review: Tested, 3/3 (planted faults found). Loop: Tested, 26 → 100 (self-scored, one cold run). Strategy Prompt: Tested, 6/6 (sections present, math rechecked). Save 10%: Tested, 37 tests (plus 40/40 trigger check). Ship-ready: Spec only, 10 cases (expected results, no run published). Goal: Spec only, 12 cases (expected results, no run published). Email Triage Pro: Spec only, 10 cases (expected results, no run published).
